Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche · Ushnisha Vijaya Puja

Dzongsar Khyentse Rinpoche presided over the inaugural Ushnisha Vijaya Puja in Vancouver.

Throughout the five-day puja, JYL Broadcast provided multi-camera coverage, live directing, livestreaming, and technical support. Our director coordinated multiple cameras in real time, shaping the visual flow through shot selection, pacing, and integrated visual effects. While preserving the solemn atmosphere of the puja, the production delivered a layered and engaging experience for both in-person and online audiences.
